Id: TrustDemoDT02
Url: TD.DT.02 Which national schedule code does an imported dose carry?
Version: 0.1.0
Title: TD.DT.02 Which national schedule code does an imported dose carry?
Status: draft
Experimental: true
Type:

system: http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/plan-definition-type

code: eca-rule

Date: 2026-11-05 14:17:56+0000
Publisher: litlfred
Description:

For one dose, decide whether and how the national schedule code is added beside the issuer's product code, which is always kept. Requirements: STD-SEM-001. Hit policy FIRST: the rules are tried in order and the first that matches applies.
Related Artifacts:

Documentation

  • Decision table TD.DT.02 (OMG DMN 1.3): vaccine-code-mapping.dmn

Dependencies

  • J3 map: vaccine product to national schedule dose
Actions:
Rule 1:

When outcome is one of reported-unverified, rejected, not-read: mappingBasis = not-imported; action = No schedule code is added. Only a verified dose is imported and mapped (J3's yes path); a reported dose keeps the issuer's code alone.
Rule 2:

When outcome is verified and mapEntry is equivalent: mappingBasis = concept-map; action = Add the mapped schedule code beside the product code. STD-SEM-001 (map): the published national map has an equivalent; both codings are kept, as in TrustDemoJ3Bcg.
Rule 3:

When outcome is verified and mapEntry is none and clinicianConfirms is yes: mappingBasis = clinician-confirmed; action = Add the confirmed schedule code beside the product code; record the clinician's attestation as a Provenance; add the pair to the national map. The map has no entry and the clinician confirms the equivalent (J3: the Hep B product). Her decision is recorded and added to the map so the next clinic need not repeat it.
Rule 4:

When outcome is verified and mapEntry is none and clinicianConfirms is no: mappingBasis = unmapped; action = Keep the product code as it is and show the dose to the clinician as unmapped; the schedule does not count it (TD.DT.03). STD-SEM-001 (unmapped): no equivalent is known, and none is guessed.
